scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Harper Annex rooftop crane setup eligible for Wednesday’s city permit review.
Emerging Need: Once curb-lane staging becomes necessary, a required traffic-control attachment is absent from the permit packet before upload intake closes.
Decision Context: Early records leave staging unsettled; later field and portal updates establish the prerequisite, deadline, and missing upload fields. The correct documentation source is only in shared compliance records.
Consequence: If the attachment is not pursued while the intake window remains open, the crane work may stay scheduled but cannot be cleared in time for the planned setup.

parameter.title: Harper Annex rooftop crane window
parameter.description: Tentative inverter-pallet lift window. Staging may use rear-lot forklift access or curb-lane crane setup depending on crate delivery constraints; city permit review is expected Wednesday.

parameter.subject: Harper Annex permit portal draft opened
parameter.body: Draft permit HAX-4260 is open for the Harper Annex rooftop lift. The attachment checklist will recalculate after final staging is selected. Upload intake for the Wednesday review closes Tuesday, August 4 at 15:00.

parameter.content: Rear-lot access is out for Harper Annex: paving fence went up this morning, and the inverter crates will not fit through the alley. Thursday's lift now has to set from the curb lane, with crane vendor standby held through tomorrow noon.

parameter.title: Harper Annex permit upload cutoff
parameter.content: PermitTech reminder for HAX-4260: lane-closure attachment fields are still empty; upload intake closes at 15:00 for the Wednesday review batch.

parameter.subject: HAX-4260 attachment intake closed
parameter.body: The Harper Annex permit packet froze at 15:00 for Wednesday review. Lane-closure attachment fields were still empty at cutoff. Late additions will route to the next weekly batch and will not be visible for the August 5 review.
